messages.success: You have entered the Gravedigger area.
messages.denied: Your level or evolution does not allow entrance to the Gravedigger area.

dialogue: The dead do not rest here. I will open the way while your strength suits this trial.
Something stirs beneath the graves. A worshipper calls to it. Hurry.
Do not pity the spirits, friend. Pity whoever wakes them.

messages.success: You are now a citizen. Drop bonus active.
messages.denied: Kibita: you cannot become a citizen right now.

dialogue: A citizen of this kingdom is never a stranger anywhere in it.
Gold buys many things. Belonging is the one worth the price.

messages.success: You have entered the Carbuncle area.
messages.denied: Your level or evolution does not allow entrance to the Carbuncle area.

dialogue: The garden grows wild and hungry. Step through while you are ready for its trial.
Carbuncles guard the beds now. They were tame once, I swear it.
Mind the roots, traveller. Some of them mind you back.

messages.success: You have entered the Kaizen area.
messages.denied: Your level or evolution does not allow entrance to the Kaizen area.

dialogue: The Dark Knight walks again. I have seen the banners from the ridge.
I will send you where the scouts do not return from. Be ready.
Kaizen took my brother. Take my directions, and take your revenge.

messages.success: You have entered the Hydra area.
messages.denied: Your level or evolution does not allow entrance to the Hydra area.

dialogue: Come closer. The hydras drown this valley and I cannot hold it alone.
Cut one head and two answer. Enter and see for yourself.
Immortal, they call it. Nothing that bleeds is immortal.

messages.success: You have entered the Elf area.
messages.denied: Your level or evolution does not allow entrance to the Elf area.

dialogue: The elves closed their borders. What they hide there began our sorrow.
The forest road is open while your strength suits this trial.
Go softly. The elves hear a sword drawn from a mile off.

messages.offer: Entrance to the Royal Cape trial.
messages.success: You have entered the kingdom area.
messages.denied: The Royal Cape trial requires a Mortal between levels 200 and 254.

dialogue: A cape is cloth. A knight is what you do while wearing it.
The trial is short. Surviving it is the long part.

messages.success: Ameria turned the fragment into Balance's Compound.
messages.denied: Ameria needs a Mortal between levels 120 and 124 carrying Balance's Piece.

dialogue: Bring me the piece and I will bind it. Balance is not found, it is made.
Power without balance is just a faster way to fall.
The trolls beyond the gate carry what I need. Take it from them.

messages.offer: Show me the First Gate Key and I will reward you.
messages.denied: Come back as a Mortal below level 41, with the First Gate Key.

dialogue: New blood! Stand straight. Show me the key and I will fill your bag.
Potions first, glory later. That is the order that keeps you breathing.
Every knight I trained started exactly where you are standing.

messages.offer: Entrance to the Bless of the God area.
messages.success: You have entered the Bless of the God area.
messages.denied: Bless of the God is for a Mortal between levels 70 and 74.

dialogue: Kneel, and the god will look east with you. The trolls wait there.
The blessing is not given. It is survived.
Seventy summers and no more. Come now, or do not come at all.

messages.offer: Entrance to the Path to Knighthood trial.
messages.success: You have entered the Path to Knighthood area.
messages.denied: Path to Knighthood is for a Mortal between levels 100 and 150.

dialogue: The green cape marks a squire. Earn it on the training ground, not here.
Every knight of this realm crossed this line first. Most crossed back.
Report to the Squad Leader. Tell him the gate guard sent you.

messages.offer: Entrance to the Balance of Power area.
messages.success: You have entered the Balance of Power area.
messages.denied: Balance of Power is for a Mortal between levels 121 and 125.

dialogue: The trolls beyond hold a shard of the old balance. Take it from them.
Two forces pull this land apart. Someone must stand in the middle.
Step through, and do not look back at me. It is bad luck.

messages.offer: Entrance to the Gargoyle's Molar Tooth area.
messages.success: You have entered the Gargoyle's Molar Tooth area.
messages.denied: Gargoyle's Molar Tooth is for a Mortal between levels 200 and 254.

dialogue: The gargoyles wake at dusk. It is dusk somewhere, so keep your shield up.
One tooth. That is all I ask. Prying it loose is the hard part.
Stone does not bleed, but it does break. Remember that inside.

messages.success: Kruno turned the fragment into Opportunity's Compound.
messages.denied: Kruno needs a Mortal between levels 70 and 74 carrying Opportunity's Piece.

dialogue: You found the piece. Give it here and I will make it whole.
The trolls carry it without knowing what it is. Lucky for us both.
Compounded, it restores what the years took from your skills.

messages.offer: Show me the Second Gate Key and I will temper your weapon.
messages.denied: Clear the first gate and bring me the Second Gate Key.

dialogue: Second gate, second lesson: a dull blade kills nobody but its owner.
Bring the key and I will put an edge on that weapon of yours.
One reward per recruit. Spend it on the weapon you mean to keep.

messages.offer: Show me the Final Gate Key and I will bless your whole kit.
messages.success: Your equipment has been blessed. Go and earn it.
messages.denied: Clear the second gate and bring me the Final Gate Key.

dialogue: Final gate. Past it there are no trainers, only monsters.
Give me the key and I will harden every piece you are wearing.
You came in a recruit. You leave this camp a soldier.

messages.offer: Bring me the Orc Emblem from beyond the final gate.
messages.success: You cleared the camp. Armia has one more defender.
messages.denied: Clear the three gates, take the Orc Emblem from their chief, then return.

dialogue: Three gates, three guards, and an orc chief behind the last one.
Bring me his emblem and I will call you a soldier, not a recruit.
Every knight in Armia stood where you stand. Most of them came back.

messages.denied: You have no entries left. Bring a Locked Seal.

dialogue: I am the only one who came back from Kefra. That should tell you enough.
One seal buys a hundred trips. Most people do not need the second one.
Step through when you are ready. I will not follow you in.
